method: Reverse valuation from reported facts: value needed = market value x ((1 + return wanted) / (1 + cash returned a year))^years; earnings needed = value / exit P/E; revenue needed = earnings / net margin; implied growth = (revenue needed / TTM revenue)^(1/years) - 1. Not a fair value or forecast.

base_rates.window: each listed company's own last three years of TTM revenue (survivors only)
